patch_description:
This cross-over merges the strongest elements from the two reference implementations by adopting a hybrid ansatz that uses:
- Pre- and post-entanglement RZ gates with per-group parameter sharing (corners, edges, center) to leverage tic-tac-toe symmetry.
- RY rotations per group (corners, edges, center) for expressive but compact single-qubit rotations.
- A parametrized CRX ring around the outer 8 qubits (shared parameter crx_ring) for efficient entangling structure.
- Hub entanglement using CRY gates from the center to the edge qubits, with a single shared parameter cry_hub_edge.

This design preserves the original inputs/outputs and maintains the same parameter budget (66 parameters) as the prior best-performing setup, while introducing the CRY hub-edge entanglement and keeping the CRX ring. The approach aims to reduce trainable parameters while improving validation performance and generalization, aligning with the crossover strategy to enhance the overall score. The rest of the training loop, data construction, measurements, and evaluation remain unchanged.

All changes are localized inside the EVOLVE-BLOCK and specifically modify the ANSATZ_SPEC generation to implement the cross-over structure.
